items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Was Pop Smith in the band with you? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: And I was in that band from '46 to '52, so we spent about, how many? Let's see, '46 to '52 is about six or seven years that we spent together; we were in the big band together. Was Pop Smith in the band with you?
